pkgmetadata.longdescription: Modrinth App is the desktop mod manager and launcher for Minecraft from the Modrinth platform: installs modpacks, mods, resource packs and shaders, and manages per-instance Java runtimes on its own. This package repacks the official prebuilt Tauri binary from the upstream .deb; it renders through the system WebKitGTK (4.1 API).
